Treatment of hypoglycaemia in a conscious child with SAM?
50 ml of 10% glucose (or sugar water) orally or by NGT, then F-75.

Rehydration fluid in SAM without shock?
ReSoMal: 5 ml/kg every 30 min for 2 h, then 5–10 ml/kg/h for 4–10 h.
Na and K content of ReSoMal?
